expected: An existing safe provider binding, with independent authorization, bounded egress and budget enforcement, before live frontier dispatch.
observed: The configured kernel model adapter accepts loopback HTTP only (Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B).
The configured Goose worker binds to the same local model.
The executable TaskSpec exposes capability grants and child allocation, not cloud authorization/egress/spend contracts.
ADRs 0008 and 0009 define the required conceptual dispatch/context boundary, but no executable frontier binding is present in the inspected runtime.
architecture_impact: None; no kernel or authority contract changed.
limitations: No claim that the host has no credentials. Credentials were not inspected; unrelated interactive client authentication is not an approved Blaine dispatch binding.
attempted: Read-only runtime/contract prerequisite inspection; no cloud inference or provider connectivity test.
decision_required: Identify an existing approved binding with its scoped authorization/egress/budget policy, or choose an isolated fake-transport validation scope before live integration.
safest_next_option: Keep runtime local-only; establish the existing ADR 0008/0009 boundary in a bounded isolated proof without changing Task authority implicitly.
